name: APA Journal Article Reporting Standards for Quantitative Research (JARS-Quant)
authority: American Psychological Association / Appelbaum et al., American Psychologist (2018) 73(1):3-25
domain: Behavioral Science, Cognitive Psychology & Psychometric Research

standards.name: Hypotheses & Structural Design Transparency
standards.description: Explicit statement of primary, secondary, and exploratory hypotheses; clear operationalization of independent and dependent variables.

standards.name: Participant Sampling & Demographic Profiling
standards.description: Eligibility criteria, recruitment settings, sample demographic profiling (age, gender, socioeconomic status), and sampling frame specified.

standards.name: A-Priori Power Analysis & Sample Size Determination
standards.description: A-priori statistical power calculations specifying alpha, intended power (1-beta >= 0.80), and expected minimum detectable effect size (MDES).

standards.name: Experimental Manipulation, Masking & Control Conditions
standards.description: Complete description of stimuli, manipulation checks, counterbalancing, control conditions, and experimenter/subject masking.

standards.name: Psychometric Construct Validity & Reliability
standards.description: Demonstrates construct validity, convergent/discriminant validity, and psychometric reliability (Cronbach's alpha, test-retest r) of behavioral tasks.

standards.name: Data Diagnostics, Outliers & Missing Data Handling
standards.description: Pre-specified outlier trimming criteria, distribution checks, and missing data imputation procedures (FIML or multiple imputation).

standards.name: Complete Statistical Reporting & Exact p-values
standards.description: Exact p-values, test statistics (F, t, Z, chi-square), degrees of freedom, and directionality reported for all tested contrasts.

standards.name: Standardized Effect Sizes & 95% Confidence Intervals
standards.description: Reports standardized effect sizes (Cohen's d, partial eta^2, standardized beta) accompanied by full 95% confidence intervals on all primary findings.

standards.name: Generalization Constraints & Boundary Conditions
standards.description: Discussion of sample constraints, cultural/demographic generalizability, ecological validity, and theoretical boundary conditions.

standards.name: Open Science & Preregistration Disclosures
standards.description: Transparent disclosure of study pre-registration, open data repositories, executable analysis scripts, and financial conflicts of interest.
